sloka: भ्रातरं पश्य भरतं त्वच्छोकाद्व्रतधारिणम् ।अभिषेचय चात्मानं पौरान् गत्वा प्रहर्षय ।। ६.१२३.२१ ।।
transliteration: bhrātaraṁ paśya bharataṁ tvacchokādvratadhāriṇam ।abhiṣecaya cātmānaṁ paurān gatvā praharṣaya ।। 6.123.21 ।।

translations.english: "Subduer of enemies! See your brothers, great souls Bharata and Satrughna devoted to you who are in grief due to your separation, see your mothers. Get consecrated. People will rejoice.
